io.style

Class AlternatingRowFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.style.AlternatingRowFactory

  • public final class AlternatingRowFactory
extends java.lang.Object
    Applies Apache POI conditional formatting rules to manage header and alternating-row appearance across specified cell ranges in a worksheet.

    Six predefined color styles are available: Grey, Coral, Soft Purple, Lime, Orange, and Sky Blue.

    Usage Examples:

    • Predefined Style: 
      
 AlternatingRowFactory factory = AlternatingRowFactory.newInstance(sheet, ColourStyle.CORAL);
 factory.apply(0, 0, rowCount - 1, colCount - 1);
    • Custom RGB via Fluent Builder: 
      
 AlternatingRowFactory factory = AlternatingRowFactory.newInstance(sheet)
         .setHeaderRowRGB(192, 80, 77)
         .setEvenRowRGB(204, 255, 204)
         .setOddRowRGB(128, 100, 162)
         .setBorderRGB(128, 128, 128);
 factory.apply(0, 0, rowCount - 1, colCount - 1);

    Change log:

    • 24 November 2021 - Initial creation.
    • 6 October 2026 - Fixed cell range bounding logic and updated documentation to match POI signatures.

    24 November 2021

      • apply

        public AlternatingRowFactory apply(int firstRow,
                                   int firstCol,
                                   int lastRow,
                                   int lastCol)
        Applies header and alternating-row conditional formatting to the specified cell range. The first row of the range is formatted as the header row. If the range contains additional rows, they are formatted using separate conditional formatting rules for even and odd numbered worksheet rows. If the supplied range is empty or reversed, no formatting is applied and this factory instance is returned unchanged.
        Parameters:
        firstRow - the first row index, inclusive
        firstCol - the first column index, inclusive
        lastRow - the last row index, inclusive
        lastCol - the last column index, inclusive
        Returns:
        this factory instance

      • getCustomBackgroundRGB

        private org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Color getCustomBackgroundRGB(int red,
                                                                 int green,
                                                                 int blue,
                                                                 org.apache.poi.hssf.util.HSSFColor.HSSFColorPredefined hssfColorIndex)
        Resolves a custom RGB colour for the active worksheet type.

        For HSSF worksheets, the requested colour is looked up in the workbook's custom palette. If it is not already present, the specified palette slot is assigned the requested RGB values and then returned. For XSSF worksheets, an XSSFColor is created directly from the specified RGB values.

        Parameters:
        red - red component, from 0 to 255
        green - green component, from 0 to 255
        blue - blue component, from 0 to 255
        hssfColorIndex - HSSF palette slot to use when the requested colour is not already present in the custom palette
        Returns:
        a Color representing the requested RGB colour
